name: Internet Futbol Manager
summary:
Internet Futbol Manager is a multiplayer football management game played in a web browser. Each player takes charge of a club in a shared online world, building a squad through transfers, auctions and loans, setting the line-up, mentality and style of play, and following every match through a play-by-play report as the club competes in national leagues, cups and international tournaments.

Clubs without a human manager are run by the computer, and groups of friends can create private leagues of their own. Player skills, morale and fitness determine how each match plays out, so squad rotation and tactical choices matter.
